name: @papercupai/starlight
description: Embed the harness docs as a dashboard tab. Successor to @papercupai/fumadocs — same iframe-tab hookup; the embedded viewer reads <projectPath>/docs/ for the active harness.
author: Papercusp

docsUrl.description: Base URL of the per-harness docs viewer embedded in the tab. The viewer reads ?harness=<slug> and renders that harness's docs/ folder — identical per-harness behaviour to @papercupai/fumadocs.
